text: 中国移动：上半年算力服务收入达到人民币529亿元，同比增长14.0%。移动云影响力进一步提升，公有云收入规模首次进入国内业界前三。数据中心收入人民币190亿元，同比增长13.2%，其中AIDC收入同比增长486.1%，敏捷交付、算电协同、高阶运维等核心服务能力显著增强。智算服务收入人民币53亿元、增速达130.1%，贡献算力服务收入增量的46.1%。云算应用收入同比增长5.9%，其中移动云盘收入同比增长14.1%。
text_en: China Mobile: H1 computing power service revenue reached RMB 52.9 billion, up 14.0% year-on-year. Mobile Cloud's influence further improved, with public cloud revenue scale entering the domestic top three for the first time. Data center revenue reached RMB 19 billion, up 13.2% year-on-year, of which AIDC revenue surged 486.1% year-on-year, with core service capabilities such as agile delivery, computing-power coordination, and high-level operations significantly enhanced. Intelligent computing service revenue reached RMB 5.3 billion, growing 130.1%, contributing 46.1% of the increase in computing power service revenue. Cloud and computing application revenue rose 5.9% year-on-year, with Mobile Cloud Drive revenue up 14.1%.
